Method of Attack: Path-traversal vulnerability allowing loading of malicious Kubernetes Helm Chart YAML files to extract sensitive information
Bypassing anti-path-traversal checks by making valueFiles look like a URI
Privilege escalation, information disclosure, and lateral movement attacks
Attack Vector: Loading malicious Helm Chart YAML files onto target system
Creating or updating applications with permission and guessing full path to valid YAML files
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Helm value files outside chart folder
Concatenated direct call to values.yaml files
